full_prompt_en: A square, painterly interior scene shows a woman seated in a deep upholstered armchair, looking down at an open book across her lap. The room around her is suggested by broad broken patches of dark plum, brown, and warm ochre rather than by sharply drawn furnishings. Behind the chair, a lighter rectangular area and a few angular marks suggest a wall or recessed feature, but the seated figure remains the unmistakable center. She sits slightly left of center with wavy brown hair falling around her face and shoulders. Her pale blouse hangs loosely at the sleeves and neckline, its folds caught in blue-white and cream strokes. A saturated turquoise sash wraps her waist and trails down beside the chair, providing the brightest cool accent in the warm room. One hand rests on the rounded arm of the chair while the other supports the book; the open pages angle toward the right and catch a broad patch of light. Her legs cross at the knee and extend down toward the lower right in slim strapped heels, creating a long diagonal against the dark seat. The chair is built from heavy brown arms, purple cushions, and rough-edged reddish upholstery, and the floor below breaks into pale gold, cream, and blue-gray reflections. The figure's face and bare legs are softly modeled, while the surrounding furniture and background loosen into visible, directional brushstrokes. Color edges shift and merge, yet the hand, book, legs, and chair remain clear enough to anchor the gesture. Warm light falls from the upper right onto the pages, blouse, and legs, while deep violet and brown shadows hold the interior around them. The overall composition balances a calm reading pose with lively paint, placing a cool turquoise ribbon and luminous skin within a warm, textured room.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、富于绘画笔意的室内场景呈现一位女子坐在深软垫扶手椅中，低头看着摊在腿上的书。周围房间由深紫、棕色和暖赭色断续大色块暗示，而不是靠清晰描画的家具来界定。椅后有一块较浅的矩形区域与几道有棱角的笔痕，让人想到墙面或凹入结构，但坐着的人物始终是明确中心。她位于中央略偏左，棕色波浪发落在脸旁和肩上。浅色上衣的袖子与领口松垂，褶皱由蓝白和奶油色笔触抓出。一条饱和的青绿色系带缠在腰间，垂到椅旁，成为暖色房间里最亮的冷色强调。一只手放在圆润的椅扶手上，另一只手托着书；打开的书页斜向右，接住一大片光。双腿在膝部交叠，穿着细带高跟鞋向右下方伸去，在暗色座椅前形成长斜线。椅子由厚重棕色扶手、紫色靠垫和粗边红调软面构成，下方地面碎成浅金、奶油与蓝灰色反光。人物面孔与裸露腿部塑造得柔软，周围家具和背景则松散成可见、有方向性的笔触。色彩边缘移动并互融，但手、书、腿和椅子仍清楚到足以稳定整个动作。暖光从右上方落在书页、上衣和双腿上，深紫与棕色阴影则围住室内。整体构图让安静的阅读姿态与活跃颜料相平衡，把冷调青绿系带和发亮的肤色放进暖而有肌理的房间。
style_prompt_en: The painting combines loosely blocked color with selective, convincing modeling at the focal area. Broad strokes of plum, umber, ochre, and gold shape a warm surrounding field, while saturated turquoise and blue-white accents create a cooler counterpoint. Edges are allowed to break, merge, and change direction; more precise passages appear only where the eye needs to understand a gesture or surface. Thick, visible brush marks carry light across planes and turn background detail into rhythmic color rather than literal description. Deep warm shadow occupies much of the frame, so illuminated pale regions feel concentrated and intimate. Diagonal gestures add movement to an otherwise settled arrangement. The overall effect is romantic, tactile, and luminous, with painterly energy held around a calm center.
style_prompt_zh: 这种画法把松散铺排的色块与焦点区域有选择、可信的塑形结合起来。深紫、赭褐、赭黄和金色的大笔触塑造暖色周围场域，饱和青绿和蓝白强调提供冷色对应。边缘可以断开、融合、转向；只有目光需要理解姿态或表面时，才出现更精确的段落。厚而可见的笔触让光在平面间流动，也把背景细节转为有节奏的色彩，而非字面描述。深暖阴影占据大半画幅，使受光浅色区域显得集中而亲密。斜向笔势为原本稳定的布置增添运动。整体效果浪漫、可感而明亮，活跃的绘画能量围住安静中心。
theme_en: A woman reading in an upholstered chair in a warm, shadowed interior
theme_zh: 一位女子坐在软垫扶手椅上，在暖而幽暗的室内读书
name: Steve Henderson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
